fusions.name: Unheard Opener
fusions.desc: Fires a round into the first enemy in its path for 5 damage, with 50% more critical chance against a target that has not yet been wounded.

fusions.name: Done Playing
fusions.desc: Fires at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 18 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Stalking Crouch
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 11% faster. Attacking breaks the veil.

fusions.name: Slip and Answer
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
